content_md: Watched *The Dirty Dozen* which was the source material for Inglorious Bastards. Came out in 1967 and the first 100 minutes are almost exactly like a Tarantino hang out movie. The guy who directed it, Robert Aldrich, seems like a big inspiration for French new wave and the post Kurosawa wave of Japanese filmmakers. There is not much of a plot, more of a frame, and what the movie excels at is really well executed beats, which is a joy to watch. ![image](media/c5fdfc066e29-image.png)
